Ten new languages, texts that fit where they didn't and a fix for a usage report I didn't know MediaPipe was sending.

## New

- Telescope now speaks German, French, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Turkish, Polish, Italian, Korean and Vietnamese. They're first drafts marked (beta) in the language list and some wording will be off until someone who speaks the language reads it through. Corrections are very welcome and [docs/translating.md](https://github.com/LunarKittyy/Telescope/blob/master/docs/translating.md) has how.

## Fixed

- MediaPipe, which the vision effects (Auto framing, Background, Privacy blur and the rest) download to find people, turned out to send Google a usage report each time it loaded a model (don't worry, it never had anything from your camera in it, just which model ran, how fast and how often). It's on by default with no setting to turn it off and I only noticed it while testing something else. The vision download now has it blocked. If you use those effects the card asks you to click **Download** once more after updating.
- Some texts got cut off in longer languages, like the Curves page in Colour grading, a Bitrate of Dynamic, the framing sliders and the flip buttons in Transforms.
